steps.text: Kazimierz Outskirts
Catapult's Hometown

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: This is the place, right?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Right, this is it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I scattered gold coins all over this street, you know?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Come on, enough of that. This street looks no different than all the other ones.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'm telling the truth.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: The truth? You?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Hahahaha.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, come on. I'm being serious.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: For real?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: For real.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Alright, alright, I'll believe you, just this once.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: When are you heading back to Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Tonight.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: You sure that's enough time?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'm just here to take a look around. Half a day's plenty of time.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: It's 7 A.M. right now.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: I'll be waiting for you around... 7 P.M. here tonight.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Sounds good.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'll bring you lots of souvenirs.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: You better make sure you don't get caught first.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Keep your terminal on you and keep the channel clear. If anything comes up, let me know right away.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, stop treating me like a kid. Off you go.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: And here I'm trying to be nice. Fine.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: I'm not giving you a ride back if I don't see any souvenirs.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: No problem, I'll make sure you get to try the dates!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Alright, let's see how this hellhole's changed.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The edge of town looks pretty much the same, but the town center...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, looks like they spent a lot of money here.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I bet that old fart wouldn't have spent even half a coin on this place.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Looks like the li'l knight who's running the joint might just be a decent fella.
The young master's alright. We've been living a much more comfortable life than before.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, long time no see. Looks like you've been holding up pretty well the last couple years, Filon.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: You got that letter, and you still came back, huh?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Look at you. You look like you're doing pretty well yourself, Arleta.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What's the deal? You never called me by my real name before.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Did you forget my nickname? Or are you looking down on me? Hm?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Catapult.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Happy?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Now that's more like it.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: You haven't changed a whole lot since the last time I saw you.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: What have you been up to out there?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: After I got out, I found myself a gruntwork gig. It pays pretty well, though, and I get to travel everywhere.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What about you? How's everything been after that whole thing?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: You wouldn't know, but not long after you left, the old bastard had the whole town searched. He didn't manage to get even a fourth of his treasures back, though.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: He was so pissed that he jacked up the tax rate.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, uhh...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So, what about now? That's still going on?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Nope. It lasted maybe two or three months.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I'm not entirely sure what happened after that, but an investigation team from the big city paid us a visit.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I don't really know what they talked about, but we never saw the old fart again. Word is he retired and went back home to rest.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Then the young master came. First, he changed the tax rate back. Then he spent a huge amount of money on the town. That's why the place looks the way it does now.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Mm-hmm, sounds like he's got a bright future as a leader.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Right, you've been away for so long, I bet you hardly recognize the town. Let me show you around.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: C'mon.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, ehhh, wait!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'm still wanted. I probably shouldn't just walk on in there.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Come on, didn't I tell you in the letter? The young master canceled all the arrest warrants that had to do with the incident.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: For real?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: What, you don't trust your old buddy Filon?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Of course I do! How could I not?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Now hurry and lead the way! I can tell from here the whole town's a maze now. I can't imagine making my way around alone.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Right, how long are you staying?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: My company's landship happens to be sailing through the area, so I took a little time off. I'll be gone by the end of the day.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Well, look at you. Keeping yourself busy even on vacation.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Come on, I actually came back to check the place out after I read your letter. Sheesh.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Now hurry. Show me around.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Alright, alright. Let's go.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Here, does this place look familiar? This is the factory I used to work at. It's been fully renovated.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: They even have air conditioning now. It's much more comfortable inside now.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Filon, I got a question.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Sup?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: They used to grow food in that patch of land all the way out of town, didn't they?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: How come it's all grapes now?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: It's not just that one spot. The young master's planning to turn all the farmland here into a huge vineyard.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: We have good soil here, and we can grow some top quality grapes. They make pretty good money.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But what about food?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You don't eat grapes for all three meals, right?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Hah, of course not.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: With the grapes, we have the money to buy food from other places.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It's all imported?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: You really got to hand it to those big shots from the cities. Thanks to them, our markets are lined with stuff that we never got to eat back in the day.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh yeah? Sounds nice.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Sounds like the young master's much more reliable than the old fart.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (But if they don't grow any food here, what will they do if the big shots in the cities raise their prices?)

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: There used to be factories all around town. The young master's planning to merge their operations, and once the big factory's open, we'll all be raking in big bucks with him.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Oh well, sounds like I'd be raining on his parade. I'll just keep it to myself.)

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Speaking of, how about I show you the factory?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Sure. The last time I was here, they didn't even have a single brick laid yet.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wow, it's huge. I bet not even the old man's mansion back home is this big.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Damn right.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: And it isn't even done yet. We're working on one side of the factory, while the other side's still being built.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Once the factory's completed, I reckon the whole town will work here.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The whole town...? No way.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: 'If you want work, then it's work you'll get.'

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: That's what the young master said.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: You remember the old man who used to feed us radishes?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The bald grandpa?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: He had a huge family, so he didn't have to work the fields himself. He had lots of free time.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Now, the young master gave him a job as a security guard.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: He's got something to do, and he can help out with his family's expenses. You should've seen how happy he was.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That sounds pretty nice.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (But... looking around... this doesn't seem like a place you could work with an easy mind...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Has the young master thought about cleaning up the area around the factory, though?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: On our way here, the entire place smelled like acid.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: He told us to bear with it, and that he'll take care of it once the factory's done.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: He's the old jerk's son, though. Do you really believe every word he says?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Well, we've all had it pretty nice the last couple years, thanks to him.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yeah, looks like you've had it better than anyone.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Haha, that's right. Much better than before.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Maybe he'll put you up for sale, and you'll even help him count his money.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Heh, I wouldn't go that far.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Then why don't you tell me what you actually got from that young master of yours?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Well, it's a long story. Why don't we find a restaurant somewhere and we'll talk there?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: A restaurant? We've got fancy stuff like that here?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Yeah, and it's cheap, filling, and delicious.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Sounds like a plan. Lead the way. I'm starting to get hungry.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: *Burp*.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: How's that? Tastes great, doesn't it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Uhh, yeah.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Here I thought it was going to be some five star restaurant.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (This is just a fast food restaurant and a pub!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (But this is much better than the scraps the old man used to give us. We sometimes had to skip meals, too.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (I guess fast food... is kind of a luxury in a way.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (The servings are big, it's filling, and it doesn't cost that much.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (But everything outside... has changed so much.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That young master isn't trying to tear down the entire town, right?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Oh, yeah, that's pretty much what he's done.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Take a guess. What do you think this fast food joint used to be?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hmmm...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The fountain square?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The square is still there, at least, right?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: It's gone.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Damn, that's my only landmark.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Let's see...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The courthouse?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Getting warmer.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That's still not it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You don't mean—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Imitates an explosion)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Bingo.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, the young master is really trying to erase all traces of the old man.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: He even rebuilt this place.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So where's the young master? Where does he live?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Right there. On the top.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: You'll know what I mean once you step outside and take a look. There isn't another building here that tall.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: All the rich and famous people in town live there.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I thought you raked in a lot of money. How come you didn't move in?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Heh, I still have a ways to go compared to those who really made it big.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I have a bit of savings, much thanks to you.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: And I hid it pretty well when the old bastard was still running things.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: But as soon as the young master came along, I thought I'd use the money to start a business.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Nice. You've always had pretty good luck ever since we were kids, and you're smart. You probably raked in tons of money, didn't you?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Ehh? Nope... It's not that easy...

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: The young master had a huge area plotted out when he started working on his factory, so I figured I would open a small shop right next to it.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: But as soon as I signed my lease, he decided to start building his factory from the other end.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Since I'd paid up already, I had no choice but to open the shop.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Only the few families in the neighborhood come visit.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I've been in the red all these years, even now.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: And I have no idea when they'll start building the factory on my side either...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But you've been tooting his horn all day long.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: You don't get it.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: We've had knight competitions here ever since that knightess lass paid the old man a visit.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: But it only got this popular thanks to the young master.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Now, not only do we get some decent games to watch...

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: (Whisper) We get to earn some cash too.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You watch the games... and you make money from that? That sounds too good to be true.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I'm not kidding.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: (Checks wristwatch)

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Perfect. This afternoon's games are about to begin.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I'll pay for your ticket. Come on.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Sounds good up front.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (But how come it feels like something's not quite right?)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Should be this row.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Sits down)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: This is a sofa?! Whoa, it's so comfy!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: This young master really spares no expense huh.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: This indoor arena's even bigger than that tower he lives in.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: It's our town's landmark, at least until the factory's all built.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: It's big, it's got style, and it's comfortable.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: We get to enjoy all this, so of course we've got a few nice things to say about him.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heh, sounds right.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: How come there's a terminal on the seat?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Oh, that?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Listen up, Catapult. This is how I make money.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: Welcome one, welcome all to the arena! I am your commentator for today's game.

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: First off, let us welcome the rising star of our town, the independent knight Raz!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Raz?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Didn't he used to be a cop for the old fart?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What's going on here?!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: A lot of people lost their jobs that day, thanks to you. Raz's one of them.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: At first, he said he was going back home to work the fields, but ever since he met that high-class knightess, suddenly all he'd say is 'I'm going to become a professional knight' and stuff.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I thought it was just talk.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: But he was serious.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: And he was one of the first to sign up when they started running competitions here.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: The guy always had decent looks, and he's not half bad too. He's pretty popular all over town.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: And of course, the most important thing is that...

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: He wins.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I'm not so sure about today's match, though...

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: And his opponent—former Glorious Shield equipment tester and independent knight—Mr. Stone!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Equipment tester...?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, hey. This guy's definitely no pushover!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Yeah, I know. Calm down.

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: Your terminals are now active.

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: Care for a little wager? Or maybe buy some chips to drop in supplies to help them out?

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: The fate of the knights lies in their hands—and yours!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The terminal's on...

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: (Taps the terminal for a while)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Quiet. Give me a minute.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: The odds are stacked against Raz... but...

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: The payout, though...

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Alright, I'm betting on Raz!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: (Taps the terminal for a while)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You bet... 5000?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That's... not a currency, right?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: It is. It's just a number right now, but whatever you punch in during the competitions, you'll have to pay if you owe anything after the match.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: There's bound to be people who can't pay it back, right?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: If you can't pay... you make it up to the young master by working for him.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Do you know what you're doing?!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I'm betting on Raz!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: As long as he wins, I'll be swimming in cash! Get it?!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I did my research. Raz's numbers don't look good, but he will win.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I'm sure he'll win!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But what if he loses?!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Right, I sometimes slip up.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: But as long as I bet on Raz, he's going to win!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Just trust him, and trust me, okay?!

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: Let the games begin!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: (Ignores Catapult and stares intently at the competition.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Filon...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Raz can't match that Stone in skills or equipment. Don't you know that?)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (He may be talented, but that's a country guard fighting a veteran mercenary!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (I know you're lucky, but this...)

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: That's it, Raz! Good one!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (He's giving it all he's got right up front. If Dobermann was here training him, he'd be getting the whip.)

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I'm telling you, Raz's going to win.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: (Enters 1000 on the terminal's keypad)

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: That's what I'm talking about, Raz! Beat the living hell out of him!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (How long will he last?)
15 minutes later...

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: What's wrong, Raz? You can take that hick!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: H-Hang in there! I'll send you some supplies!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: (Taps the terminal for a while)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (His opponent is starting to fight back...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Hold on?!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That outsider hick's not holding back at all!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I-It's a no-limits match...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: My money... M-My money...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Switches on the comms)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whispers) Hey, can you hear me?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Loud and clear. What's the matter?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Are you getting arrested?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whispers) Something like that. Get ready, and drive to the arena in the town center.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whispers) Think you'll be able to get us out alive?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Understood, and worry about yourself first.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Keep the channel open.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whispers) Thanks.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Reloads ammo)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Pressurizes weapon)

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Raz! Raz, you can't lose!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: I don't care if you die, but what about my money?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Out of the way!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (It won't be easy to land this hit without collateral damage from this distance...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Aims)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Argh, whatever! I'm going for it!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Raz, you're a good guy. You shouldn't die here.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (After this, we'll be even, and there'll be nothing left for me here.)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Alright, you big dummy, come closer!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Pulls the trigger)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Concentrates)

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: What a beautiful shot!!!!

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: Just as victory was within reach, Mr. Stone suddenly turned toward the audience.

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: And our little fella took his chance!

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: He raised his sword and struck his opponent down in one hit!

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: A textbook comeback!

steps.name: Commentator
steps.text: Victory goes to the independent knight—Raz!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: H-He won?!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: He won! He won!! I won!!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: What did I tell you, huh, Catapult?

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Whenever I put money on Raz, he wins! Every time!

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Hahahahahaha!!!!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Lowers weapon)

steps.name: Filon
steps.text: Catapult. Catapult?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: I'm here. Look to your right.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Coming.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Looks like shit didn't hit the fan.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Guess nothing good came of your visit, then.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Is it like this everywhere in Kazimierz?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: The competition knights and the arenas?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Yeah, it is.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What time is it?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Around 5 or 6 P.M.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Let's find some dinner, get some souvenirs, and head on back.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And get as far away from this stinking place as we can.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Skurwysyny.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Well, get in the car.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: There's a guy running toward us with a big bag of cash. Is that a friend of yours?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: An acquaintance, that's all.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Now floor it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Not necessary. His bag's got a hole.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Did he turn back to pick up his money?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: (Turns steering wheel)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Looks like he went back. You still want a look?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Nah, why would I?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ahhh—I'm starving.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Let's get some grub, brother.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: Can't you see I'm driving?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: But don't you worry, Catapult. I looked a place up.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Personnel
steps.text: We're almost to the restaurant.
